textTemplates.name: SVC_EmailBody
textTemplates.text:
Dear {!SVC_MainFlowContact.FirstName},
Thank you for contacting Standard Bank today.
We were glad to assist you with your request.
Your reference number for this engagement is: {!SVC_MainFlowCase.CaseNumber}.
You can use this reference number if you would like to contact us about this request again in the future.
Kind regards, Standard Bank

textTemplates.name: SVC_SelfServiceScript
textTemplates.text: "{!SVC_MainFlowContact.FirstName} I just want to inform you that this request can be fulfilled through the Mobile App or Internet Banking channels. Would you like to receive the documentation on the steps to self-service your request via email?"
